name: com.avn.qa
description: Debug-only QA bridge for AVN games. Exposes level, state, UI and named actions to AVN PlayLens over a loopback socket. Compiled only when the AVN_QA scripting define is set.

samples.description: Registers the standard ad.* and iap.* actions against the AVN plugin. Wire the TODO lines once in the plugin.
Shows how a game registers its level provider, game state and level.* actions.
